coverage_statement: This package freezes a sparse curation boundary for a non-public Globe MVP. It does not claim complete coverage of Leonardo, central Italy, the Renaissance or synchronous world history, and it contains no publication-ready historical geometry or World Model Claims yet.

known_gaps.description: The two candidate cartographic-coverage Region versions have not been digitized or independently reviewed.
known_gaps.effect: Historical Region geometry is null and cannot be rendered or promoted.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Record source-image rights, digitization method, CRS/control points, reconstruction mode, alternatives and two independent geometry reviews.

known_gaps.description: The selected institutional sources establish endpoint contexts but do not establish a route between Imola and Florence.
known_gaps.effect: The trajectory contains an inferred_gap with no line geometry.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Retain unknown_route unless a reviewed source supports a route or an explicitly analytical uncertain corridor.

known_gaps.description: The candidate registry points to live institutional pages; exact normalized source passages are not yet pinned as immutable review artifacts.
known_gaps.effect: Candidate assertions cannot become READY Claim/EvidenceLink records.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Create rights-compliant immutable locator evidence or bibliographic page/section locators and verify every atomic Claim.

known_gaps.description: No independent content or validator-integrity review has been completed for this real slice.
known_gaps.effect: The package remains candidate_not_ready and promotion_allowed=false.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Complete two independent reviews on one frozen commit with no unresolved critical finding.

known_gaps.description: Only one global simultaneity candidate is selected at scope-freeze time.
known_gaps.effect: The slice cannot imply representative global coverage.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Review the user task and either justify one anchor as sufficient or add the smallest additional source-bound context.

known_gaps.description: Issue #331 is paused, so documented encounter, interaction, influence and causal predicates are prohibited.
known_gaps.effect: Only deterministic derived co-presence may be computed and it cannot be stored as a historical Relation.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Resume and accept #331 before introducing any documented Relation predicate.
